Summary

Source: R/dx_itd.R
summary.dx_itd.Rd

Summary

Usage

# S3 method for class 'dx_itd'
summary(
  object,
  variable = NA,
  label = NA,
  show_var = TRUE,
  show_label = TRUE,
  measure = NA,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

An object of class "dx_itd"

variable

Variable to include in returned values

label

Labels to include in returned values

show_var

Include variable column in returned data?

show_label

Include label in returned data?

measure

Measures to include

...

additional arguments to be passed to or from methods

Value

A table of the measures and their summaries, made with knitr::kable(). If knitr is not installed, a data frame.

Examples

data <- dx_heart_failure
data$predicted[seq(5, 261, by = 20)] <- NA
fit <- dx_itd(data, pred_varname = "predicted", true_varname = "truth")
summary(fit, show_var = FALSE)
